description: Schema migration + modules 21 (tax) and 22 (revenue). These are the foundation: schema adds TaxRate, Report enums/model, AlertRule+AlertFiring, Notification enum/model, and two fields on WebhookDelivery (status, payload). Tax and revenue are implemented first because reports (FEAT-002) calls the revenue service and tax applies to invoices. FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 depend on this FEAT being committed.
steps: 1. Edit prisma/schema.prisma (at c:\Users\Coding-Kimz\Desktop\crazy\llah\prisma\schema.prisma). Add enums: ReportType { INVOICE_SUMMARY REVENUE_SUMMARY SUBSCRIPTION_SUMMARY USAGE_SUMMARY TAX_SUMMARY }, ReportStatus { PENDING PROCESSING COMPLETED FAILED }, AlertMetric { USAGE_AMOUNT INVOICE_OVERDUE_DAYS PAYMENT_FAILURE_COUNT MRR_DROP_PERCENT }, AlertOperator { GT GTE LT LTE }, NotificationType { INVOICE_CREATED INVOICE_PAID INVOICE_OVERDUE PAYMENT_FAILED SUBSCRIPTION_CANCELED SUBSCRIPTION_RENEWED ALERT_FIRED CREDIT_APPLIED REFUND_ISSUED SYSTEM }.

2. Add models TaxRate, Report, AlertRule, AlertFiring, Notification to schema.prisma per the exact SDL in the plan file at c:\Users\Coding-Kimz\Desktop\crazy\llah\.agents\tasks\modules-21-30-plan.md (Step 1). Add back-relations taxRates[], reports[], alertRules[], notifications[] to the Organization model.
3. Patch WebhookDelivery in schema.prisma: add 'status String @default("PENDING")' and 'payload Json?' fields.
4. Run: cd c:\Users\Coding-Kimz\Desktop\crazy\llah && npx prisma validate. Fix any errors before continuing.

5. Run: npx prisma migrate dev --name modules_21_30. This creates the migration and regenerates the Prisma client. If DATABASE_URL or DIRECT_URL is not available in env, run 'npx prisma generate' only (to regenerate client from existing schema) and note migration must be applied manually.

6. Create apps/api/src/modules/tax/validators.js: export createTaxRateSchema (name string, rate number 0-100, country string length 2, region optional, active optional bool), updateTaxRateSchema (all partial), taxRateIdSchema ({ id: cuid }), calculateTaxSchema ({ amountMinor int, country, region? }), applyTaxSchema ({ country, region? }).

7. Create apps/api/src/modules/tax/service.js: import prisma from '../../lib/prisma.js'. Implement createTaxRate(orgId, data), listTaxRates(orgId, filters), getTaxRate(id, orgId) with 404, updateTaxRate(id, orgId, data), deleteTaxRate(id, orgId) as soft-delete (active=false), calculateTax(orgId, { amountMinor, country, region }) — find most-specific TaxRate (country+region first, then country-only), compute taxAmountMinor = BigInt(Math.floor(Number(amountMinor) * Number(rate) / 100)), applyTaxToInvoice(invoiceId, orgId, { country, region }) — fetch DRAFT invoice (422 if not DRAFT), call calculateTax, prisma.$transaction to create InvoiceLine (description='Tax', quantity=1, unitAmountMinor=taxAmountMinor, metadata={type:'TAX',taxRateId}) and update invoice (taxMinor, totalMinor=subtotalMinor+taxAmountMinor).

8. Replace apps/api/src/modules/tax/router.js entirely: import Router, requireOrg, requireAuth from correct paths (requireAuth is NOT re-imported — it is already applied in routes.js; only requireOrg is needed here), import service and validators. router.use(requireOrg). Wire: GET /, POST /, GET /:id, PATCH /:id, DELETE /:id, POST /calculate, POST /invoices/:invoiceId/apply. Each handler: try/catch/next(error), res.json({ data }), 201 for POST, 204 for DELETE.

9. Create apps/api/src/modules/revenue/validators.js: export periodQuerySchema ({ from datetime, to datetime, granularity enum day/week/month default month }), churnQuerySchema ({ from, to datetime }).

10. Create apps/api/src/modules/revenue/service.js: import prisma. Implement getMRR(orgId) — find ACTIVE subscriptions with plan.items.price, sum BigInt(price.unitAmountMinor) * BigInt(planItem.quantity ?? 1) for each item across all subs; getARR(orgId) — getMRR * 12n; getRevenueByPeriod(orgId, { from, to, granularity }) — find PAID invoices in range, group by truncated date using a JS Map, return sorted array of { period: string, revenueMinor: bigint }; getChurnRate(orgId, { from, to }) — count active-at-start (created before from, not canceled before from) and count cancelations in period; getRevenueStats(orgId) — run all four queries in parallel, return { mrrMinor, arrMinor, totalRevenueMinor, activeSubscriptions, activeCustomers }.
11. Replace apps/api/src/modules/revenue/router.js entirely: router.use(requireOrg). Wire GET /mrr, GET /arr, GET /stats, GET /by-period, GET /churn.
